findings.cause: Nonblocking job snapshot fixes a potentially one-job cohort and prevents admission of later available jobs while Run/Close proceeds.
findings.evidence: candidates/D/host.go:43; candidates/D/host.go:73; candidates/D/host.go:139; evidence/D-host-independent.log: TestIndependentLaterAvailableInputStarts misses second Run while first holds 1 of 2 slots; evidence/D-minimum-independent.log: same positive first-start and bounded second-start test; evidence/D-host-contract.log: supplied partial-start setup cannot reach blocked third admission
findings.correction: Keep admission responsive while capacity remains and successful acquired jobs can run; retain the cohort join/Close barrier at release.

findings.cause: Close results are accumulated in result but never mark the cohort failed.
findings.evidence: candidates/D/host.go:156; candidates/D/host.go:161; evidence/D-host-independent.log: limit 1 produces three opens/closes after first Close failure; evidence/D-minimum-independent.log: same intended count assertion
findings.correction: Set failed/cancel after any Close error while finishing every acquired release, then stop admission.

strengths.evidence: The exact Job/Lease/Serve API remains compatible and construction stays host-owned through the Open function, with no unrelated framework/public API; both actual toolchains compile every source package.
